title: Foundry-Fabricated Silicon Nitride Grating Arrays with Uniform Power Distribution at Visible Wavelengths
abstract: Multiplexed optical biosensors are widely deployed to read out many biological targets in parallel. However, their channel count and integration density are limited by the photonic network that delivers light to individual sensing sites. Existing on-chip networks have been largely developed for phased arrays and image projection, where performance is assessed through an aggregate radiation pattern rather than the local intensity at each output. In this Letter, we demonstrate a novel bus-and-tap network architecture for massively parallel multiplexed optical delivery. The network uses cascaded directional couplers with individually designed interaction lengths, allowing for arbitrary, user-defined illumination patterns not possible with conventional binary tree architectures. We experimentally validated our proposed architecture with 46 visible-wavelength grating emitter channels designed for uniform illumination at 40 $\mu$m pitch in a commercial 300-mm silicon nitride foundry process, achieving an emitted-intensity coefficient of variation of 9.3% at 530 nm, and 8.8% under band-integrated illumination from 550 nm to 650 nm. These results provide a route to scalable visible-light delivery for sensing, imaging, neural interfaces, and parallel optical addressing in quantum systems.

summaries.en: The paper presents a foundry-fabricated silicon nitride bus-and-tap photonic network that uses cascaded directional couplers with tailored interaction lengths to deliver user-defined, uniformly distributed visible illumination, experimentally demonstrated with 46 grating channels showing 9.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种采用级联定向耦合器并为其定制相互作用长度的总线-抽头光子网络，用以在商用300毫米硅氮化物工艺中实现可定义且局部强度均匀的可见光并行传输，并通过46路光栅发射通道实验验证：530 nm下发射强度变动系数为9.

title: Black-Hole Ringdown from Photon-Sphere Modes in an Elastic Analogue
abstract: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) govern the ringdown of black holes, yet their physical origin and experimental accessibility remain limited. Here we create an elastic analogue of a black hole using a curved metallic shell engineered to emulate a Schwarzschild-like metric, and directly probe its vibrational dynamics in the time domain. Following impulsive excitation, the elastic system exhibits a clear ringdown response, providing a tangible analogue of black-hole ringing. The underlying modes are flexural vibrations localized near the photon sphere. A reduction of the thin-shell elastic equations yields a photon-sphere effective potential and predicts the dependence of the localized-mode frequencies on azimuthal order. Crucially, they persist even when boundary reflections are strongly suppressed, demonstrating that their confinement is governed by a curvature-induced effective potential rather than by cavity boundaries. This platform enables direct access to quasinormal modes through both their temporal decay and spectral signatures, establishing a direct connection between photon-sphere dynamics and ringdown. More broadly, our results identify curvature-induced trapping as a general mechanism for wave localization and dissipation in open systems.

summaries.en: The paper reports an elastic curved-shell analogue of a Schwarzschild black hole that, when impulsively excited, shows time-domain ringdown dominated by flexural photon-sphere–localized quasinormal-like modes whose frequencies depend on azimuthal order and persist without boundary reflections, highlighting curvature-induced effective trapping as a general mechanism for wave localization and dissipation in open systems.
summaries.zh: 本文通过构建一个模拟施瓦西黑洞的弯曲金属壳弹性类比系统，在冲击激发后在时间域直接观察到清晰的环形衰减响应，表明其由位于光子球附近的横向弯曲振动（类准正规模）主导；进一步推导了薄壳方程并得到光子球有效势，能够预测这些局域模频率随方位量子数的变化，而且即使强烈抑制边界反射，这些模仍然存在，说明其束缚源于曲率诱导的有效势而非腔体边界。

title: Efficient third-harmonic generation in high-Q tantalum pentoxide microcavities
abstract: Nonlinear harmonic generation in microcavities offers a compelling route toward energy efficient on-chip short-wavelength coherent light sources, enabled by tight optical confinement within compact mode volumes and flexible dispersion engineering. Tantalum pentoxide (Ta2O5) photonic platforms are particularly promising for realizing such nonlinear processes: their broad transparency window (280-8000 nm) supports broadband operation, their large bandgap suppresses two-photon absorption, and their thick-film deposition capability enables dispersion management--features that can collectively enhance the performance of nonlinear light sources. Here, we demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, the first efficient third-harmonic generation (THG) in high-Q Ta2O5 microcavities. These microcavities feature smooth surfaces and high loaded Q factors up to 2.67X10^6, thereby facilitating nonlinear interactions. Through dispersion engineering, efficient THG is realized in both suspended microdisks and monolithic microrings under telecom-band continuous-wave laser pumping, as confirmed by optical spectra, visible-light microscopy, and the near-cubic pump-power dependence of the conversion efficiency. This work lays a foundation for chip-scale f-3f self-referencing of frequency combs and next-generation integrated nonlinear photonics.

title: Reconfigurable Free-Space Optical Interconnects
abstract: Free-space optical interconnects can support many low-data-rate channels while avoiding the cost, energy consumption, and packaging constraints of optical waveguide- or fiber-based systems that are widely used today. We propose a free-space optical interconnect system based on reconfigurable micromirror arrays, and show that it scales favorably due to its two-dimensional scaling. We discuss the channel count scaling model, compare our demonstration with theory, and project a channel count above 10,000 to achieve 100 Tbps with slow channels (e.g., <10 Gbps). In a proof-of-concept system with a piston-motion micromirror array, we demonstrate nine channels that are simultaneously optimized. The optimization enables -21.7 dB of average worst-case crosstalk for a channel pitch equal to twice the beam radius, a smaller channel spacing than that required in flat tip-tilt mirrors. The optimization flow is further investigated for different channel spacings, simultaneous illumination, and different numbers of outputs, which generally achieve smaller worst-case crosstalk than the flat tip-tilt mirror case. Overall, the work demonstrates the advantage of piston-motion micromirrors in the proposed optical interconnects.

summaries.en: The paper proposes reconfigurable free-space optical interconnects using micromirror arrays, models and compares channel-scaling to project over 10,000 channels (100 Tbps) and experimentally demonstrates a nine-channel piston-motion micromirror system achieving optimized crosstalk of -21.
summaries.zh: 论文提出基于可重构微镜阵列的自由空间光互连系统，建立并对比信道数量的扩展模型并预测可实现超过一万信道（100 Tbps），同时实验演示了采用活塞式（piston-motion）微镜的九信道系统，在信道间距为波束半径两倍时实现平均最坏情况串扰-21.

title: All-photonic millimeter-wave and terahertz signal core at room and cryogenic temperatures
abstract: Millimeter-wave and terahertz technologies offer new opportunities for high-capacity communications, sensing, and quantum systems, but electronic signal chains above 100 GHz are limited by weak sources, noisy receivers, and lossy interconnects. Photonic approaches mitigate these constraints by enabling chip-scale high-frequency components, yet existing implementations generally retain lossy off-chip electrical or free-space links, hindering dense and compact integration for cryogenic or space-constrained settings. Here, we show a monolithic lithium tantalate photonic chip, termed a signal core, which generates, modulates, routes, and detects continuous-wave signals at discrete frequencies between 100 GHz and 2.5 THz. The architecture integrates high-frequency functional modules on chip and uses exclusively fiber-based optical interfaces. Bidirectional coherent electro-optic conversion enables signal generation, detection, and nanosecond-scale amplitude and phase modulation, while micro-coplanar striplines interconnect the modules into an end-to-end signal chain on a single chip. Our modules achieve single-photon electro-optic coupling rates of g_0/2\pi=10 kHz and peak drive-power-normalized photon-flux conversion efficiencies of 1.0%/mW for generation and 0.5%/mW for detection. It also operates at 4 K in a dilution refrigerator through the same fiber-only optical links. Together, these capabilities establish an all-photonic platform for millimeter-wave-to-terahertz systems and offer a broadly applicable architecture for applications constrained by electrical-interconnect loss, heat load, and footprint.

summaries.en: The paper presents a monolithic lithium tantalate all-photonic “signal core” that generates, routes, modulates, and detects continuous-wave 100 GHz–2.

title: Laser-design methodology for extending an available wavelength range of dual-wavelength injection-seeded laser
abstract: This paper describes a method for expanding the applicable wavelength range of dual-wavelength oscillation injection-locked lasers. Special focus is placed on the laser design that enables simultaneous oscillations at both the gain center and gain tail, requiring the most stringent requirements. We show that a sufficient performance can be achieved by introducing a wavelength-dependence property onto the output coupling mirror, without giving any losses in the laser resonator. We also show how we can determine such wavelength-dependent property on the basis of experimental measurements. Using the designed output-coupler, in practices, we demonstrate simultaneous oscillations with an equal output power, across a variety of wavelength combinations of near the gain center and around the gain tail in which the wavelength separation amounts 60 nm at the most.

summaries.en: The paper presents a laser-design and experimental method that extends the usable wavelength range of dual-wavelength injection-seeded injection-locked lasers by engineering a wavelength-dependent output-coupling mirror to enable simultaneous oscillation at the gain center and gain tail without resonator losses, demonstrating equal-power dual-wavelength operation over combinations separated by up to 60 nm.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种激光设计与实验确定方法，通过在输出耦合镜上引入波长相关特性、在无谐振腔损耗的前提下实现增益中心与增益尾的同步振荡，从而扩展双波长注入种子注入锁定激光的适用波长范围，并用该设计的输出耦合镜在波长组合（中心附近与增益尾附近）中实现了输出功率相等的双波长同时振荡，最大波长间隔可达60 nm。

title: Efficient Modeling of 3D-Printed Freeform Waveguides with a Transformation Optics-Based Beam Propagation Method
abstract: An efficient numerical method is introduced for simulating wave propagation in 3D-printed freeform waveguides, referred to as photonic wire bonds (PWBs). This approach integrates transformation optics (TO) with curvilinear meshing to map the original 3D freeform PWB structure onto a straight waveguide, which possesses anisotropic material characteristics. The resulting waveguide is then analyzed using an anisotropic full-vectorial beam propagation method (BPM). To validate the performance and effectiveness of the proposed TO-BPM algorithm, a comparison is made with the finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) technique. Our approach reduces the simulation time by more than two orders of magnitude, depending on the degree of trajectory bending, in combination with a mean absolute percentage error (MAPE) of 3.9% in power transmission simulation relative to the FDTD.

summaries.en: The paper presents a transformation-optics-based, curvilinear-meshing beam propagation method (TO-BPM) that maps 3D-printed freeform photonic wire bonds to a straight anisotropic waveguide and uses an anisotropic full-vectorial BPM to achieve over two orders of magnitude faster simulation than FDTD with a 3.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种结合曲线网格的变换光学（TO）光束传播方法（TO-BPM），将3D打印的自由形状光子线键（PWB）映射到具有各向异性材料特性的直波导上，并用各向异性的全矢量BPM进行分析；与FDTD相比，该方法在仿真速度上提高超过两个数量级（取决于轨迹弯曲程度），且功率传输结果的平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）为3.

title: Shaping Near Fields of Photonic Modes into Topological Textures
abstract: Topological textures of light, such as optical vortices and skyrmions, are attractive for high-density information encoding and light-matter interactions. In the near field, topologies have primarily been realized using polaritonic platforms that inherently tie the platform to the material dispersion, limiting their footprint due to propagation losses and restricting their operating spectral region. Here, we introduce a route to shape near-field topologies through the geometric engineering of a dielectric metasurface supporting a quasi-bound state in the continuum resonance, without the need for polaritonic surface waves. In-plane deformation of our metasurface bars conserves their resonance-driven near-fields locally, so that the metasurface geometry and the polarization of the illuminating light dictate the generated topology. By shaping silicon unit cells into geometries with rotational symmetry, we create optical topologies with controllable topological charge. Using phase-resolved scattering-type near-field optical microscopy, we experimentally characterize high-purity resonance-locked topologies such as vortices in concentric rings and topological charge doublets in Archimedean spirals. In contrast to conventional topological textures, our purely photonic mode-based field textures are stationary standing waves in the radial direction, without relying on surface-wave propagation or polaritonic dispersion, establishing a spectrally and spatially scalable platform for near-field topological photonics.

summaries.zh: 论文提出一种纯光学介电超表面，通过几何工程准束缚在连续谱（BIC）的共振态来生成可控拓扑电荷的近场拓扑纹理（如同心环涡旋与阿基米德螺旋中的电荷双点），并借助相位分辨的散射型近场显微镜进行实验表征；该平台不依赖极化激元色散或表面波传播，因而具备在光谱与空间上的可扩展性。

title: Second- and third-order nonlinearities in silicon nitride waveguides via heterogeneous integration of lithium niobate membranes
abstract: Thick, dispersion-engineered silicon nitride is a leading platform for integrated third-order nonlinear optics, supporting supercontinuum and frequency comb generation. However, it lacks the second-order nonlinearity required by many applications. Here we bond pre-fabricated x-cut thin-film lithium niobate membranes onto finished silicon nitride waveguides as a back-end step, compatible with commercially fabricated waveguides. A single silicon nitride waveguide generates an octave-spanning supercontinuum and, through the lithium niobate membrane, concurrent second-harmonic, sum- and difference-frequency generation. These results open new possibilities for thick silicon nitride photonics, from visible light generation to on-chip $f$-$2f$ comb self-referencing, a key step towards miniaturised timing and navigation quantum technologies.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates back-end heterogeneous integration of x-cut lithium niobate membranes onto finished dispersion-engineered silicon nitride waveguides, enabling simultaneous octave-spanning supercontinuum generation and lithium-niobate-facilitated second-harmonic, sum- and difference-frequency generation in a single device for applications such as visible light generation and on-chip f–2f comb self-referencing.
summaries.zh: 论文通过将预制x切薄膜锂铌酸锂膜作为后端步骤键合到完成的色散工程化硅氮光波导上，实现单器件中同时产生八度跨越超连续谱，以及由锂铌酸锂膜驱动的二次谐波、和频与差频生成，从而为可见光产生和片上f–2f梳自参考等应用提供了可能。

title: Predictive electronic feedback control for narrow-linewidth lasers
abstract: Narrow-linewidth lasers are essential for various key atom-laser interaction processes and optical setups in quantum coherent control, quantum precision measurement, and quantum information science. The Pound-Drever-Hall (PDH) technique is the standard method for the frequency-stabilization of narrow-linewidth lasers, but the inherent time delay in its feedback loop inevitably induces excessive phase noise, commonly known as servo bumps. Previous solutions primarily rely on additional optical components outside the electronic feedback control loop. Here, we propose and implement a generic method based on the Smith predictor to address the time-delay issue entirely within the electronic part of the PDH feedback control loop. We systematically demonstrate its capability to suppress phase noise and reduce servo bumps by adding only a single Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) controller to the loop. This class of methods is demonstrated to be conceptually concise with minimal hardware overhead, effective in practice, and holds potential for a wide variety of future applications.

summaries.en: The paper presents a Smith-predictor-based electronic modification to the standard Pound–Drever–Hall laser frequency-stabilization loop that uses only a single FPGA to cancel feedback time-delay effects, thereby suppressing phase noise and eliminating servo bumps for narrow-linewidth lasers used in quantum technologies.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于史密斯预测器的电子改进方案，用少量硬件（在PDH锁频反馈回路中仅加入单个FPGA控制器）来抵消反馈时间延迟效应，从而抑制相位噪声并消除窄线宽激光中的伺服突波，面向量子技术中的相关应用。

title: Nanopillar metasurfaces uniting high optical reflectivity with ultracoherent nanomechanics
abstract: Mechanically compliant mirrors are key components in cavity optomechanics. However, the requirements to achieve the best optical and mechanical performance are usually in direct competition. A high reflectivity for tightly focused beams entails thick reflectors, whereas ultracoherent flexural nanomechanics necessitates thin membranes. We eliminate this trade-off by introducing high-refractive-index nanopillar metasurfaces on top of a thin membrane. We pattern a 50 micrometer-diameter array of nanopillars to form a photonic crystal. The flat band behavior of guided resonances in the photonic crystal enables a reflectivity of 99.82(1)% for a tightly focused beam of 7 micrometer waist. The combination of two guided resonances creates a 100 nanometer-wide high-reflectivity band around 1550 nanometer. Simultaneously, the nanopillar patterning realizes a density-modulated phononic crystal that isolates an ultracoherent localized mechanical mode with a $Q\cdot f$-product of $2\cdot 10^{14}$Hz. The demonstrated nanopillar metasurfaces enable lightweight mirrors for room-temperature quantum optomechanics and for use as levitated mirrors or lightsails.

title: Observation of Polarization Topology in Magneto-Optical BICs
abstract: Polarization topology in momentum space is a fundamental characteristic of photonic bound states in the continuum (BICs), where the winding of far-field polarization defines a quantized topological charge. Although magneto-optical (MO) BICs combine polarization topology with magnetically tunable chirality, experimental characterization remains challenging because time-reversal symmetry (TRS) breaking complicates eigenpolarization extraction. Here, we experimentally resolve the momentum-space polarization topology of an MO BIC by reconstructing its two-dimensional far-field eigenpolarization texture. We extract the resonant output polarization using singular value decomposition of the polarization-resolved angle-resolved reflection matrix without invoking reciprocity. The reconstructed polarization azimuth winds counterclockwise by 2$\pi$ around the $\Gamma$-point singularity, yielding a topological charge of q = +1. Moreover, the polarization handedness can be reversed solely by varying the magnetic-bias strength, while the field direction and the measured topological charge remain unchanged. A non-Hermitian coupled-mode model traces this reversal to hybridization between the BIC mode and a leaky mode. This work establishes experimental access to momentum-space polarization topology in nonreciprocal photonics, opening a route to explore topological singularities and their evolution under active TRS breaking.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally reconstructs the momentum-space polarization topology of a magneto-optical bound state in the continuum by extracting far-field eigenpolarization without reciprocity and finds a counterclockwise 2π polarization winding around the Γ-point (topological charge q=+1) whose handedness reverses with magnetic bias via non-Hermitian hybridization between the BIC and a leaky mode.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在不依赖互易性的情况下重建磁光BIC的动量空间远场本征偏振纹理，实验解析其偏振拓扑并观察到Γ点附近偏振方位逆时针绕行2π（拓扑电荷q=+1），同时仅通过改变磁偏置强度即可反转偏振手性，其机理由非厄米耦合模中BIC模与泄漏模的杂化所致。

title: Confinement of hybridized light modes in nonlinear-optical superpotentials
abstract: In this work, we present a spatial and temporal light trapping mechanism induced by coherent frequency conversion. We consider a wave-mixing process, where a pumped nonlinearity mediates a frequency-domain beamsplitter interaction between two signal modes. When these wave modes are counterpropagating, temporally trapped eigenmodes emerge at the zero of the nonlinearity profile. We establish that such spatio-temporal trapping has a direct connection to supersymmetric quantum mechanics, which ensures the existence and robustness of the trapped modes and allows us to derive analytic solutions of the bound eigenmodes. Backwards sum-frequency conversion may thus enable a unique class of active photonic memory devices, whose design parameters are compatible with the state of the art in integrated nonlinear photonics. We propose proof-of-principle experiments to study this nonlinear-optical trapping effect on thin-film lithium niobate. In addition, as a case study, we show how the temporal trap can be used alongside parametric gain. Our work unveils potential applications ranging from classical integrated photonics to multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a nonlinear-optical light-trapping scheme based on coherent frequency conversion in a wave-mixing process, showing that counterpropagating signal modes form robust spatio-temporally confined eigenmodes linked to supersymmetric quantum mechanics with analytic solutions, and suggesting integrated lithium-niobate experiments and applications such as active photonic memory and multimode quantum nonlinear photonics.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于相干频率转换的非线性光俘获机制：在波混频过程中，由受泵浦的非线性充当频域“光束分裂器”耦合两个信号模，当两模反向传播时会在非线性空间轮廓的零点形成时域被俘获的本征模，并证明这种时空俘获与超对称量子力学直接关联，从而保证被俘获模的存在与鲁棒性并给出解析解，同时提出在薄膜铌酸锂平台进行验证性实验，并展示其与参数增益的结合及在主动光子存储与多模量子非线性光子等方面的应用潜力。

title: Phase-Matched Chirps for Energy-Efficient Excitation of Magneto-Mechanical Resonators
abstract: Magneto-mechanical resonators (MMRs) are a recently proposed class of passive, wireless devices used for sensing and tracking. The operating principle of MMRs relies on an excitation of the sensor by oscillating magnetic fields, followed by an inductive readout to measure the sensor's dynamics. One challenge lies in generating efficient excitation signals to ensure maximum energy harvesting by the sensor. In this simulation study, we focus on chirped magnetic-field excitations and compare their performance with conventional constant-frequency excitation for both sinusoidal and rectangular waveforms. The results indicate varying levels of efficiency, with a sinusoidal linear down-chirp excitation signal yielding the largest deflection angle, offering the best potential for reducing the energy consumption and improving the temporal resolution of the measurement.

summaries.en: The paper uses simulations to compare chirped versus constant-frequency magnetic-field excitations for magneto-mechanical resonators, finding that a sinusoidal linear down-chirp produces the greatest deflection angle and thus the most energy-efficient sensing with improved temporal resolution.
summaries.zh: 论文通过仿真比较磁-机械谐振器中啁啾与恒频磁场激励的效果，结果表明正弦线性下啁啾能产生最大的偏转角，因此在提升测量时间分辨率的同时具有最佳能量效率潜力。

title: Orbital-coherence memory in electrical transport and its self-consistent Maxwell response
abstract: An internal electronic coherence changes electrical transport only when it feeds back on the physical current. We develop a reduced description of this feedback and distinguish its exact consequences from the assumptions required for a microscopic realization. An opposite-parity two-orbital Hamiltonian identifies a current-coupled orbital force. Under an explicitly stated moment closure and collision ansatz, it yields a passive three-state response with an exponentially damped oscillatory memory. The resulting conductivity redistributes a fixed optical weight and predicts a nonmonotonic dependence of dc conduction on coherence damping at fixed remaining parameters. The orbital reduction constrains the coupling and internal frequency through a shared bare splitting, providing a test beyond unconstrained spectral fitting. A charge-conserving spatial extension couples to Maxwell equations through a positive energy balance and separates the constitutive response from longitudinal collective and transverse electromagnetic modes. We formulate complex-conductivity and transmission tests, including the limits of parameter identification over a finite bandwidth. The model supplies a conditional connection between orbital dynamics, transport memory, and electromagnetic observables; conductivity alone does not establish a uniquely quantum mechanism, and a material-specific collision calculation and closure-error assessment remain necessary.
subjects: Applied Physics (physics.app-ph) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: The paper develops an orbital-coherence memory model for electrical transport that self-consistently feeds back into current and couples to Maxwell electrodynamics, yielding a passive three-state exponentially damped oscillatory response with conductivity reshaping and nonmonotonic dc behavior tied to coherence damping, plus conductivity/transmission tests that highlight limits of uniquely identifying quantum mechanisms without material-specific collision modeling and closure-error assessment.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一个轨道相干记忆模型，用于描述相干如何通过反馈到物理电流并与麦克斯韦电磁方程自洽耦合，从而得到被动的三态、指数阻尼的振荡记忆响应；该模型导致导电率在固定光学权重下重新分配，并在参数保持不变时预测dc传导随相干阻尼的非单调变化，同时给出复杂导电率与透射测试以评估有限带宽内参数识别的局限，强调仅靠导电率无法唯一确定量子机制，还需要材料特定的碰撞计算与闭合误差评估。

title: Normal-Form Characterization of Adaptivity and Entanglement in Pauli-Based Computation
abstract: Pauli-based computation (PBC) is a measurement-based model of quantum computation that samples from output distributions of universal Clifford+$T$ circuits. Here, we provide a normal form (NF) that completely characterizes its adaptive and entanglement structures. These insights unify PBC with one-way quantum computing as dual or `time-reversed' counterparts. We use the NF to advance strategies for distributed computation and investigate magic-state injection rates. We also demonstrate an exponential improvement in the detection of unnecessary magic-state qubits, allowing their efficient removal. Our NF further enables ahead-of-time circuit compilation using PBC, reducing CNOT gate count and quantum memory of random quantum circuits on average by 50% and 40%, respectively, beating other state-of-the-art compilers.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a normal-form characterization for Pauli-based computation that fully captures its adaptive and entanglement structure, links it to one-way (time-reversed) quantum computing, and uses it to optimize distributed computation, magic-state injection/removal, and ahead-of-time compilation with significantly reduced CNOT counts and memory for random circuits.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种对Pauli型量子计算（PBC）适应性与纠缠结构的完备法则（normal form）表征，并将其与单向（时反）量子计算统一起来，进而用于优化分布式计算、魔态注入率/不必要魔态淬除，以及进行先行电路编译，在随机电路中将CNOT门数与量子内存平均分别降低50%和40%，并优于现有最先进编译器。

title: Delta-Doped GeV$^-$ in diamond with isotope resolvable optical spectra
abstract: Group IV color centers in diamond -- silicon, germanium, tin, and lead-vacancy centers -- are a promising platform for quantum networking. Typical Group-IV creation utilizes ion implantation during diamond growth that leaves the color centers with a broad depth distribution and damage-induced strain inhomogeneity. Deterministic placement and damage reduction in Group IV generation are essential for improving this platform. In this letter, we report on the localization of germanium-vacancy (GeV$^-$) to a $<$ 10 nm layer via the timed injection of GeH$_4$ during microwave plasma chemical vapor deposition. In this layer we have realized 17 ppm of Ge and a strain-free environment for the GeV$^-$. Subsequent electron irradiation and annealing have generated a sheet density of 0.12 GeV$^-$/$\mu$m$^2$. The minimal damage from color center generation mitigates spectral inhomogeneity and allows spectral resolution of isotopic clusters, with the best cluster having an inhomogeneous distribution of 2.14 GHz and an average linewidth of $47 \pm 11$ MHz. Our study gives insight into formation dynamics of GeV$^-$ in delta-doped systems and estimates our vacancy to GeV$^-$ yield to be $\geq$ 90%, establishing an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model. We further characterized the spin $T_2^*$ and set a lower bound of 730 ns, limited by a paramagnetic defect.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates delta-doped GeV⁻ formation in diamond using timed GeH₄ injection to localize germanium within <10 nm, producing low-strain, low-damage centers that enable isotopically resolved optical spectra with narrow linewidths and a high (≥90%) vacancy-to-GeV⁻ yield consistent with an athermal nearest-neighbor formation model, while reporting a spin T₂* lower bound of 730 ns limited by a paramagnetic defect.
summaries.zh: 论文通过在微波等离子体化学气相沉积中定时注入GeH₄实现δ掺杂，使Ge在<10 nm内局域化并获得低应变、低损伤的GeV⁻色心，从而实现可分辨同位素簇的窄线宽光谱；同时估算空位到GeV⁻的产率≥90%并与非热最近邻形成模型一致，且测得自旋T₂*下限为730 ns，受限于顺磁缺陷。

title: Memory--Transport Competition in Physical Two-Bath Quantum Reset Dynamics
abstract: Coherence preservation and environmental renewal offer competing ways of controlling quantum memory and transport. We show that a seemingly natural protocol which exactly replaces the bath occupations while preserving arbitrary system--bath coherences need not correspond to a physical fermionic state. We instead construct a two-reservoir protocol with independent, number-conserving thermal attenuators, for which complete positivity and fermionic admissibility hold by construction. Physical attenuation necessarily modifies bath populations as well as cross correlations; the coherence control is not an independent hard-reset knob. Quadratic dynamics reduces the stroboscopic problem to an exact matrix fixed-point equation without a weak-coupling or Markov approximation. Analytically, coherence retention enhances the leading short-cycle transfer rate, including the complete-erasure limit; no general endpoint-vanishing theorem exists. An exact stationary continuity theorem forces the through-current to vanish whenever either reservoir is left entirely unrefreshed, although no analogous theorem suppresses it at complete erasure. For biased structured reservoirs, exact finite-chain calculations display distinct coherence-, current-, and signed energy-transfer operating points; a resolved high-retention boundary layer exposes strong finite-size sensitivity of the coherence peak. The model provides a microscopic, fermion-admissible benchmark for the interplay of reservoir coherence, particle transport, and energetic exchange.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes two-bath quantum reset dynamics in fermionic systems, showing that memory preservation via bath-occupation replacement generally fails physical fermionic admissibility, and proposes a completely positive two-reservoir protocol using number-conserving thermal attenuators whose quadratic dynamics yields an exact matrix fixed-point formulation revealing how coherence retention boosts short-cycle transfer (including at complete erasure) while continuity constraints only enforce vanishing through-current when a reservoir is unrefreshed, with finite-chain studies of biased structured reservoirs showing strong size-dependent coherence-current-energy operating points and boundary-layer behavior.
summaries.zh: 本文研究费米系统中的双浴量子重置动力学，指出仅凭“替换浴占据以保留任意系统-浴相干”的自然协议通常不对应可实现的物理费米态；作者提出一个使用相互独立、保持粒子数的热衰减器的双储备方案以确保完全正性和费米可容性，并在二次动力学下将乒周期问题精确化为矩阵不动点方程，结果表明相干保留会增强领先的短周期输运速率（甚至在完全擦除极限仍然如此），连续性定理仅在有任一储备完全不更新时强制穿越电流为零而不限制完全擦除情形，且对偏置结构化储备的有限链精确计算揭示相干、 电流与有符号能量转移的不同工作点及高相干区边界层所体现的强有限尺寸敏感性。

title: Distributed dual-comb spectroscopy
abstract: We propose distributed dual-comb spectroscopy, a quantum-enhanced sensing architecture that simultaneously exploits spatial- and spectral-domain entanglement to improve the extraction of global spectroscopic information across broadband frequency ranges. Our scheme consists of a network of Mach-Zehnder interferometers interrogating spatially separated samples, each driven by a classical frequency comb at the bright port. A single two-mode squeezed frequency comb is distributed through a passive beam-splitter array into $K$ entangled combs, establishing multipartite correlations across sensors while preserving intrinsic spectral entanglement. The protocol is compatible with both heterodyne detection and division detection, and enables parallel estimation of weighted-average absorption features over multiple frequency components. Compared with spatially separable quantum strategies requiring $K$ independently engineered nonclassical comb sources, our approach achieves enhanced signal-to-noise performance using only a single quantum resource distributed across the network. These results establish a scalable route toward broadband distributed quantum spectroscopy with simultaneous spatial and spectral advantage.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a scalable distributed dual-comb spectroscopy architecture that uses a single distributed two-mode squeezed frequency comb to generate spatially and spectrally entangled multipartite correlations across an interferometer network, enabling parallel quantum-enhanced estimation of broadband absorption features with either heterodyne or division detection and outperforming schemes requiring multiple independently engineered nonclassical comb sources.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种可扩展的分布式双梳光谱方法：通过将单个两模压缩频率梳分配到由多级马赫-曾德尔干涉仪构成的传感网络中，利用空间与光谱域的纠缠产生多方关联，从而在异源/分裂检测下并行估计宽带吸收特征，并在仅需单一量子资源分发的情况下，相比必须独立制备K个非经典梳源的空间可分策略获得更好的信噪比表现。

title: Photon localization: Local measurements, localized states, and causality
abstract: We review what it means for a relativistic particle to be localized and argue that the most useful approach is through local measurement. This perspective ties localization directly to relativistic causality and measurable outcomes in spacetime. Strict localization in quantum field theory is formalized by states that give the same expectation value as vacuum for all local observables outside some spacetime region. With this formalism, single photons cannot be strictly localized, but coherent states can. The structure and interpretation of local observables and local operator algebras are discussed in connection with the Reeh-Schlieder theorem. Since probabilities of local measurement outcomes cannot vanish in vacuum, particle detection events must be phrased carefully. Key characteristics of strictly localized states are surveyed alongside concrete strategies for constructing them. The relationship between localization, causality, and on-demand sources is analyzed, finding that strictly localized states can represent localized, propagating information in quantum field theory. Explicit examples of localized photonic states are presented with an emphasis on quantum optics, including states that approximate single photons and (entangled) Bell states.

summaries.en: The paper argues that relativistic particle localization is best understood via local measurements tied to causality, formalizes strict localization in quantum field theory using vacuum indistinguishability for all observables outside a region, shows single photons cannot be strictly localized while coherent and certain constructed localized photonic states can, and analyzes implications for detection probabilities, the Reeh–Schlieder theorem, and causality-focused connections to on-demand sources with explicit quantum-optical examples including approximate single photons and Bell states.
summaries.zh: 本文主张相对论性粒子的“定位”应通过与时空因果性直接关联的局域测量来理解，并在量子场论中用“除某时空区域外对所有局域可观测量其真空期望值相同”来形式化严格定位；结果表明单光子无法严格定位，而相干态及按特定策略构造的严格定位光子态可以，并结合Reeh–Schlieder定理讨论局域可观测量结构与检测概率的表述问题，同时分析定位、因果性与按需光源的关系，给出量子光学中的具体例子，包括近似单光子与（纠缠的）Bell态。

title: On the Structure of Quantum Finite-Level Systems: Decoherence-Free Subsystems, Quantum Nondemolition Variables, and Back-Action-Evading Measurements
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to conduct a comprehensive structural analysis of quantum finite-level systems in the Heisenberg picture, where the evolution of system observables is modeled by bilinear quantum stochastic differential equations (QSDEs). Firstly, real coordinate transformations that preserve commutation and anticommutation relations are characterized, and relative admissibility between different orthonormal Hermitian bases is formulated. Secondly, strongly aligned subspaces are introduced, based on which decoherence-free subsystems (DFSs) are constructed in general orthonormal Hermitian basis as well as the generalized Gell-Mann basis. Thirdly, conditions for the existence of quantum nondemolition (QND) variables are given in terms of both linear systems theory and spectral separation by output-signal observables. Finally, a sufficient condition for quantum back-action-evading (BAE) measurements is established. A four-qubit nearest-neighbor Heisenberg chain with collective dephasing illustrates these structural properties of quantum finite-level systems.

summaries.en: This paper structurally analyzes quantum finite-level systems in the Heisenberg picture using bilinear QSDEs by characterizing admissible coordinate/base transformations, constructing decoherence-free subsystems in general and Gell-Mann bases, deriving existence conditions for quantum nondemolition variables via system-theoretic and spectral-output criteria, and giving a sufficient condition for back-action-evading measurements, illustrated with a four-qubit nearest-neighbor Heisenberg chain under collective dephasing.
summaries.zh: 本文在海森堡表象下以双线性量子随机微分方程刻画量子有限能级系统的可观测量演化，依次刻画保持对易/反对易关系的坐标变换与基的相对可容许性、在一般正交厄米基与广义Gell-Mann基下构造退相干无关子系统、给出量子非消元(QND)变量的存在条件（系统理论与输出信号谱分离两种表述），并建立量子后向作用逃逸(BAE)测量的充分条件，最后用四比特近邻海森堡链在集体去相干下展示这些结构性质。

title: High-fidelity and robust controlled-Z gates for superconducting transmon qubits. II. System-parameter uncertainties and overall errors
abstract: In the companion paper (Part I), we developed an optimal-control framework to suppress intrinsic and decoherence-induced errors in controlled-Z (CZ) gates between directly coupled, frequency-tunable transmons. Here, we extend this framework to incorporate uncertainties in coupling strength, anharmonicities, and zero-flux qubit frequencies, enabling the design of high-fidelity gates robust against noise and parameter uncertainties. We classify these uncertainties by whether they perturb the off-diagonal coupling strengths or the diagonal detunings of the Hamiltonian, and we identify distinct suppression mechanisms for each class. Coupling errors are mitigated through dynamical decoupling induced by strong detuning modulation. For a 30-ns gate, this strategy reduces the coupling error to $6.21\times10^{-7}$ and tolerates coupling-strength uncertainties up to $2\pi\times4$ MHz while keeping total gate infidelity below $10^{-3}$. Detuning errors are minimized near a symmetric-detuning operating point that balances the two dominant leakage-mediated interactions. A 24-ns gate operated near this point tolerates individual uncertainties of up to $2\pi\times5$ MHz in each relevant diagonal parameter under the same infidelity threshold. We further optimize gate performance under realistic conditions where intrinsic errors, decoherence, and parameter uncertainties coexist across six representative stages of progressively improving hardware performance. The resulting stage-specific controls achieve lower infidelity and greater robustness. Together with the companion study (Part I), this framework offers a practical approach to balance speed, fidelity, and robustness while reducing the need for exhaustive characterization and frequent recalibration in large-scale superconducting quantum processors.

summaries.en: The paper extends an optimal-control design for high-fidelity, robust superconducting transmon controlled-Z gates to explicitly handle uncertainties in coupling strength, anharmonicities, and zero-flux frequencies, showing that dynamical decoupling via strong detuning modulation suppresses off-diagonal coupling errors while operating near a symmetric detuning point balances leakage-mediated detuning errors, yielding example 30 ns and 24 ns CZ gates with total infidelity below 10^-3 even under MHz-scale parameter variations and further improving robustness across hardware development stages when intrinsic errors, decoherence, and uncertainties coexist.
summaries.zh: 本文在对直接耦合频率可调的超导跨姆特朗CZ门的最优控制鲁棒设计（Part I）基础上，进一步纳入耦合强度、反常数与零磁通频率的不确定性以实现对噪声和参数偏差的高保真鲁棒CZ门；作者将不确定性按其对哈密顿量的非对角耦合或对角失谐的扰动类型分类，并给出各自不同的抑制机制：通过强失谐调制诱导的动力学解耦来压制耦合误差、并在对称失谐工作点附近最小化失谐误差（该点平衡两种主导的由泄漏介导的相互作用），从而在示例30 ns与24 ns门长下，即使参数变化达到多MHz仍可使总门保真度误差低于10^-3；同时在六个逐步提升的硬件阶段中将本征误差、退相干与参数不确定性共同考虑，得到阶段特定的更低误差与更强鲁棒性，从而在大规模处理器中降低对详尽表征与频繁重标定的需求。

title: Time-reversal-based quantum metrology in a central-spin architecture: from SATIN to butterfly echo
abstract: We investigate quantum-enhanced time-reversal-based metrology using the central spin model, in which a single ancilla spin of magnitude $S_{\rm cen}$ mediates interactions between $N$ bath spins through a star-graph topology. We demonstrate that the SATIN (Signal Amplification Through Time-reversal Interaction) echo protocol can be implemented in this setup to achieve a Fisher information of $N^2/e$ with the collective $\langle J_y\rangle$ readout, corresponding to a $4.34\,\mathrm{dB}$ offset from the Heisenberg limit. Furthermore, we establish that this platform provides a pathway to perform the butterfly echo protocol by conjugating each evolution step with a random collective bath rotation, thereby achieving axis-agnostic Heisenberg-scaled sensing. Crucially, with a small $N-$independent number of random steps, the butterfly echo reaches a Fisher information of $N^2/4$ ($6\,\mathrm{dB}$ below the Heisenberg limit) for any unknown encoding axis, with the plateau gain tracking the Haar limit. Finally, we demonstrate that the central-spin magnitude $S_{\rm cen}$ provides a powerful knob to reduce the optimal protocol timescale without altering the metrological ceiling or the circuit depth required to reach isotropy. The proposed scheme is relevant to cavity QED and NMR quantum processors, where the central spin architecture arises naturally.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Quantum Gases (cond-mat.quant-gas); Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech)

summaries.en: The paper shows that SATIN time-reversal quantum metrology can be implemented in a central-spin star-graph architecture to achieve Fisher information N^2/e with collective J_y readout and extends this to a butterfly-echo scheme that attains axis-agnostic Heisenberg-scaled sensing (Fisher information N^2/4 with small, N-independent random steps), while also using the central-spin magnitude to reduce optimal protocol times without changing the metrological ceiling or isotropy circuit depth.
summaries.zh: 论文在中心自旋星形拓扑架构中实现了基于时间反演的SATIN量子测量，使在集体J_y读出下费舍尔信息达到N^2/e，并进一步通过对每一步演化施加随机集体浴自旋共轭实现蝶形回波，从而在未知编码轴下以少量且与N无关的随机步数获得各向无关的海森堡尺度精密度（费舍尔信息为N^2/4，约比海森堡极限低6 dB），同时利用中心自旋大小作为旋钮在不改变计量上限或达到各向同性所需电路深度的情况下降低最优协议时间，并指出该方案适用于腔量子电动力学与NMR量子处理器中的中心自旋实现。

title: Entanglement certification of attosecond light fields with photoelectron interferometry
abstract: The emergence of entangled quantum optical states in high-harmonic generation raises a fundamental problem about its characterization, namely, \textit{how can entanglement of extreme-ultraviolet radiation be certified for attosecond light fields?} Here, we provide experimentally accessible separability tests, particularly showing that attosecond photoelectron interferometry provides a direct solution to this problem. This is achieved by a quantum optical treatment of mapping photoelectron interferometry to the measurement of optical correlation functions. This yields a negative-partial-transpose witness for infrared-XUV entanglement and a sufficient witness of genuine multipartite entanglement without auxiliary optical measurements. We evaluate both witnesses on explicit optical states and identify how the protocol can be extended to XUV-XUV entanglement certification. Hence, we establish attosecond photoelectron interferometry as a general framework for entanglement certification across a wide range of optical frequencies.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and experimentally validates an entanglement-certification method for attosecond extreme-ultraviolet fields using photoelectron interferometry, by mapping the interferometric measurement to optical correlation functions to obtain a negative-partial-transpose witness for IR–XUV entanglement and multipartite entanglement witnesses without auxiliary optical measurements, and it outlines extensions to XUV–XUV entanglement.
summaries.zh: 论文提出并实验验证了一种利用阿秒光电子干涉来对极紫外阿秒场进行纠缠认证的方法：通过将干涉测量映射到光学关联函数，可获得用于红外–极紫外纠缠的部分转置否定（NPT）见证以及无需辅助光学测量的真多体纠缠见证，并给出了扩展到极紫外–极紫外纠缠认证的方案。

title: Can Entanglement-Induced Feature-Map Designs Improve Projected Quantum Kernels?
abstract: Projected quantum kernels (PQKs) have emerged as a notable approach to circumvent the hardness of machine learning tasks arising from the exponential dimensionality of the quantum Hilbert space. However, recent PQK studies often rely heavily on extensive classical hyperparameter tuning of the radial basis function (RBF) kernel parameter and the support vector machine regularization parameter. The extensive tuning can mask the true representational power of the underlying PQKs induced by quantum feature maps, which has not been explored in detail. Thus, this work aims to expose the structural capabilities of PQKs by isolating and evaluating their native inductive bias through comparisons between untuned and tuned PQKs against the RBF baseline. Furthermore, we propose novel quantum feature maps that leverage two-qubit entanglement to capture multivariate correlations in IoT data. The results show that extensive tuning can lead to competitive performance architectures, while our proposed entanglement topologies exhibit a significantly stronger native inductive bias. This reveals that superior quantum architectural design can yield structurally better PQKs with improvements arising from quantum-mechanical properties rather than from classical hyperparameter tuning.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Machine Learning (cs.LG)

summaries.en: The paper finds that heavy classical hyperparameter tuning in projected quantum kernels can obscure their true inductive bias, and shows that newly proposed two-qubit-entanglement feature maps for IoT data produce PQKs with significantly stronger native representational power than RBF baselines, yielding competitive performance from quantum architectural design rather than tuning.
summaries.zh: 论文指出，投影量子核（PQK）中大量的经典超参数调优会掩盖其真正的归纳偏置，并表明为物联网数据提出的基于双量子比特纠缠的特征映射能显著增强PQK相对于RBF基线的先验表征能力，从而证明性能提升更多来自量子架构设计而非调优。

title: Rank-One Loss Maximizes the Spectral Response Strength of Passive Full-Order Exceptional Points
abstract: We consider finite-dimensional non-Hermitian systems in which all modes coalesce at a single exceptional point. For a rank-one anti-Hermitian contribution, the spectral response strength is computed exactly. For passive systems, we then derive a sharp upper bound at fixed exceptional-point decay rate and show that it is reached only when the decay operator has rank one, corresponding to a single independent dissipative direction. This establishes rank-one loss as the optimal configuration for enhancing the response of a full-order exceptional point. The bound holds for arbitrary order and improves on earlier passive estimates beyond second order. Two third-order trimers illustrate the result: a rank-one-loss system saturates the bound, whereas a passive rank-two-loss realization remains below it. The result turns dissipation into a design resource: concentrating the loss into a single effective dissipative direction maximizes the highest-order spectral response of a passive full-order exceptional-point device.

summaries.en: The paper exactly computes the spectral response strength of finite-dimensional passive full-order exceptional-point systems with rank-one anti-Hermitian loss, proving that at fixed exceptional-point decay rate a sharp upper bound is achieved only when the decay operator has rank one (a single dissipative direction), thus establishing rank-one loss as the optimal way to maximize the highest-order spectral response beyond earlier passive estimates and confirming it with third-order trimer examples.
summaries.zh: 本文在有限维非厄米系统中研究全阶（满阶）异常点下所有模态共聚的情形，精确计算了具有秩一反厄米损耗时的光谱响应强度，并对无源系统在固定异常点衰减率下给出严格上界，证明该上界仅在损耗算符为秩一（仅一个独立耗散方向）时达到，从而确立秩一损耗是最大化无源全阶异常点器件最高阶光谱响应的最优配置；结果对任意阶数成立且优于早先二阶之后的估计，并通过三阶三聚体例子验证：秩一损耗可达上界，而秩二无源实现则低于上界。

title: High-fidelity entanglement of two spectrally-distinct solid state emitters
abstract: Solid state quantum emitters with electronic spin properties can be entangled using optical interferometric which-path erasure techniques that rely on identical frequencies and linewidths of the emitters. This promises a powerful, fast and scalable platform for quantum technologies. Using current protocols, a pair of emitters embedded in a waveguide interferometer can be deterministically prepared in a maximally entangled state. However, the amount of entanglement diminishes rapidly with increasing separation of the emission lines and variations in the linewidths of the emitters. Solid state emitters such as quantum dots are subject to intrinsic variations in the fabrication process. Therefore, manufacturing the required number of identical emitters on a chip is not scalable. In this Letter, we present a method that uses readily available pairs of entangled photons to entangle solid state emitters with large transition frequency separations and linewidth variations, circumventing the need to fabricate optically identical emitters. We demonstrate a concurrence of C = 0.95 for typical quantum dots using narrowband photon inputs.

summaries.en: The paper proposes and demonstrates a waveguide-interferometric protocol that uses readily available entangled-photon pairs to deterministically entangle two spectrally distinct solid-state emitters despite large transition-frequency separations and linewidth variations, achieving high fidelity with concurrence C=0.
summaries.zh: 本文提出并实验证明一种波导干涉仪方案：利用现成的纠缠光子对来对两个光谱差异很大的固态发射体进行确定性纠缠，从而绕过对光学完全相同发射体的制造需求，实验中在窄带光子输入下对典型量子点实现了高纠缠度（并发度）C=0.

title: Problem-aware sampling for bias and variance reduction in randomised Hamiltonian simulation
abstract: Randomised quantum simulation algorithms such as qDRIFT reduce circuit depth by replacing deterministic product formulas with stochastic compilations, but achieving high accuracy can require many steps. In vanilla qDRIFT, Hamiltonian terms are sampled with probabilities proportional to their coefficient magnitudes. We propose StateDRIFT, a variant of qDRIFT which optimises its sampling distribution to estimate time-evolved quantities using knowledge of the initial state and target observable, with a provable truncation bound that keeps qDRIFT's guarantees. The distribution at each depth is chosen by solving an optimisation problem targeting bias and/or variance. StateDRIFT can significantly reduce the bias and variance of estimators, and hence circuit depth, which we test on short-time dynamics of lattice models and molecules under Jordan-Wigner up to 18 qubits. For example, with BeH2 StateDRIFT can reduce the number of two-qubit gates required to achieve a given accuracy from 11,201 to 983. StateDRIFT involves measuring observables and commutators on the initial state, so we propose two practical ways to estimate these: classical surrogates such as tensor networks, and classical shadows, which recover most or all of the saving from exact oracles in the systems tested.

summaries.en: The paper introduces StateDRIFT, a state- and observable-aware variant of qDRIFT that optimizes the term-sampling distribution to reduce bias and variance while preserving qDRIFT’s truncation guarantees, thereby substantially lowering the circuit depth for randomized Hamiltonian simulation and demonstrating large gate reductions (e.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种面向初始态与目标可观测量的 qDRIFT 变体 StateDRIFT，通过求解优化问题来选择随机采样分布以降低估计器的偏差和方差，同时保持 qDRIFT 的截断保证，从而显著减少随机哈密顿量模拟所需的电路深度，并在 Jordan-Wigner 下的格点模型与分子短时动力学实验中（如 BeH2 将所需两比特门数从 11201 降至 983）验证效果，且给出了基于张量网络替代与经典阴影的可行估计方法。

title: ArcTN: Efficient Tensor-Network Contraction Planning for Quantum Circuit Simulation
abstract: Tensor-network simulation of quantum circuits depends on contraction orders with low computational cost and small intermediate tensors, found without excessive planning time. We present ArcTN, a contraction-order optimization framework with two search presets. Light keeps planning overhead low, and Heavy spends more effort on refinement. Both combine randomized-greedy construction, subtree reconfiguration, and parallel tempering with stage-specific stopping rules. ArcTN also provides Fixed and Dynamic slicing to meet tensor-size limits and executes the returned orders. On the 30 QC32 quantum-circuit networks completed by all eight compared configurations, Light reduces FLOPs by 61.32% and plans 1.62$\times$ faster than Cotengra Auto/CMA-ES, and Heavy reduces FLOPs by 43.83% and plans 7.21$\times$ faster than Cotengra AutoHQ/Optuna. Heavy also needs 11.85% fewer FLOPs than OMECO TreeSA-8 and plans 1.33$\times$ faster. Dynamic slicing meets the size limits in all 90 runs on 18 scalar-output networks and reduces total sliced FLOPs by 31.99% relative to Fixed slicing, at the cost of longer planning. With a common NumPy executor, Heavy has the lowest combined planning and execution time among five configurations on the runs that all of them completed. On 672 networks built from 320 MQT Bench circuits, Heavy obtains the lowest geometric-mean FLOPs on the 142 large networks while planning 3.1$\times$ and 31$\times$ faster than Cotengra AutoHQ and Hyper128.

summaries.en: ArcTN is a tensor-network contraction-order planning framework for quantum circuit simulation that uses randomized-greedy construction, subtree reconfiguration, and parallel tempering with preset refinement levels and optional fixed/dynamic slicing, achieving large FLOP reductions and substantial speedups versus prior tools across multiple quantum-circuit network benchmarks.
summaries.zh: ArcTN是一种用于量子电路张量网络仿真的收缩顺序规划框架，通过随机贪婪构建、子树重配置和分阶段的并行回火，并提供固定/动态切片选项，在多组量子电路网络基准上相较既有工具实现了显著的FLOP降低与计算速度提升。

title: Fock-space relativistic coupled-cluster study of systematic shifts and fine-structure constant sensitivity in {\rm Cf$^{17+}$}, {\rm Cm$^{15+}$} and {\rm Bk$^{16+}$} highly charged ions
abstract: Highly charged ions (HCIs) are among the most promising candidates proposed for the development of next-generation optical clocks and the precision tests of fundamental physics. In this work, we investigate the clock-relevant properties of $\rm Cf^{17+}$, $\rm Cm^{15+}$ and $\rm Bk^{16+}$ HCIs using Fock-space relativistic coupled-cluster (FSRCC) theory. The corrections from Breit interaction, QED effects and perturbative triples are incorporated to improve the accuracy of results further. We compute excitation energies, transition amplitudes, lifetimes, hyperfine structure constants, electric quadrupole moments, and electric dipole polarizabilities for low-lying states of these ions. These properties are further used to characterize important clock transitions and estimate key systematic frequency shifts. Our calculations reveal that the proposed clock transitions exhibit strongly suppressed systematic frequency shifts. We also compute the sensitivity coefficients, $q$, and enhancement factors, $K_{\alpha}$, for the proposed clock transition as a probe to variation in the fine-structure constant, $\alpha$. Our calculations predict exceptionally large $K_{\alpha}$ of $-55.3$ and $57.5$ for $5f_{5/2} \rightarrow 6p_{1/2}$ transition in $\rm Cf^{17+}$ and $6p_{1/2} \rightarrow 5f_{5/2}$ transition in $\rm Bk^{16+}$, respectively. These giant $K_{\alpha}$s place the proposed transitions among the most sensitive optical probes for the laboratory searches for $\alpha$ variation. Further, a comparative analysis of proposed transitions in $\rm Cm^{15+}$ and $\rm Bk^{16+}$ shows that, $5f_{5/2} \rightarrow 5f_{7/2}$ transition possess smaller systematic shifts and is therefore attractive for precision frequency metrology, whereas $6p_{1/2} \rightarrow 5f_{5/2}$ transition exhibit significantly enhanced sensitivity to $\alpha$ variation.

summaries.en: Using Fock-space relativistic coupled-cluster theory with Breit, QED, and perturbative triples corrections, the study computes clock properties, systematic shifts, and fine-structure-constant sensitivity for Cf17+, Cm15+, and Bk16+, finding strongly suppressed systematic shifts and exceptionally large enhancement factors (Kα≈−55.
